task_spec: Large feature PR: an order-checkout pipeline across money.py, tax.py, promo.py, cart.py, inventory.py, checkout.py. The end-to-end contract is in checkout.py's docstring; helper contracts are in each helper's docstring.

bugs.description: to_cents does int(dollars*100), truncating float error: to_cents(0.29) == 28, to_cents(1.1) == 109 (or similar), silently losing a cent on many values. Should round, e.g. round(dollars*100).

allocate rounds each share independently, so the parts need NOT sum to `total` (violating its own docstring). Non-local: checkout uses it for per_item_tax, so the reported per-item taxes won't add up to the charged tax.

Unknown region silently defaults to a 0% rate, so orders in an unconfigured region are charged NO tax instead of raising. Non-local: a bad `region` arriving at checkout produces a silently untaxed order.
is_valid checks expiry but never enforces promo['min_order'] (documented in its own docstring), so a promo is applied even when the order is below its minimum-order threshold.

remove_item mutates self.items but does NOT invalidate self._subtotal (unlike add_item). After a remove, subtotal() returns the STALE cached value. Non-local: checkout reads cart.subtotal() and charges the pre-removal amount.
reserve uses `stock > qty`; it should be `>=`. Reserving exactly the available quantity fails, so a customer can never buy the last units in stock.
The loop applies discount for EVERY valid code, but the spec allows at most one promo per order — discounts stack.
taxable = sub taxes the PRE-discount subtotal; the spec says tax is on the post-discount amount (sub - disc). Over-taxes whenever a promo applies.

Inventory is reserved BEFORE gateway.charge (spec: only after payment), AND the return value of reserve() is ignored, so a failed reservation does not abort the order (spec requires it to). Two spec violations in one line.
total is charged with no guard that it is >= 0. With stacked discounts (b7) or an oversized promo, total = sub - disc + t can be negative, charging a negative amount. Spec: never negative.

provenance.note: 6-file, 10-bug dense PR with deep non-local root causes; built to stress even Opus (recall as fraction, coverage limit)
